header.description: Authored for mini. The state a Gated DeltaNet layer hands on, read after the prompt and at every decode step. In the continuation frame a position is a decode step, and the state there is the one that step's forward hands on — after the token it processed. Step 0 is the prompt's own forward, so its state is the state after the prompt, the same tensor {'index': -1} reads in the prompt frame. {'frame': 'generated', 'all': true} reads every step and stacks them, a (key, value) matrix per head flattened per step. No new frame and no per-kernel fire: the recurrent state is addressed with the positions every other place has.
